title: Capitol Records Building

terrainReference.basis: Original terrain next to the Vine Street frontage of the podium. Threshold heights are approximate.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap way 422141102 supplies the native building outline. Building parts 907834019 and 907834020 distinguish the cylindrical tower and low podium. Los Angeles HCM 857 confirms the identity.
mapIdentity.scope: OpenStreetMap way 422141102 and building parts 907834019 and 907834020 fix the podium perimeter, circular tower and adjoining parts. The map and city review establish the primary tower height.

note: The July 2022 street photograph establishes the silver-white disc ledges, wraparound glazing, sign and spire. The July 2009 aerial corroborates the permanent podium, upper service volume and blank northeast arc. The 128-meter elevation source sets the entry datum.
